quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are pointed upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling a right turn. Watch for this signal if you are following the driver.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. Drivers must follow all rules on regulatory signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic flow. Drivers must obey them. This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks are ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to make space for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Look carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing the road.
Follow the detour to avoid hazardous work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid hazardous work zones.
questions.explanation: These signs show that traffic patterns have changed due to construction. Follow the detour route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign directs you to take a detour around the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your car will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. If you see this sign, stop and turn around. You are going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down to safely take these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Always come to a full stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down at a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. Come to a complete stop and let other traffic go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes are becoming one. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign means no right turns at this location.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Vertical traffic lights have red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom. Horizontal lights have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Stay alert and watch for vehicles entering the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride beside the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that an intersection is coming. Be ready to watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to be alert and ready to stop for hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before driving forward.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions ahead or nearby.
It helps you find cities and towns.
It tells you traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions ahead or nearby.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let traffic on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that the road will become divided ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits only.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are for buses and carpools only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows the direction of a sharp curve. The arrow points left, so the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A traffic signal ahead is showing red.
A traffic signal ahead is broken.
A traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign tells you:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are poor. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a bridge with narrow lanes ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then curves left.
The road ahead curves left, then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then curves left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all cars and pedestrians cross first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let other cars and pedestrians go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for all cars and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. Slow down and drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing where the tracks dip low. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign sets the minimum speed you must drive. Do not drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn left or go straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
There is an intersection coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. All traffic in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers must merge smoothly from both lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It is reserved for buses and cars with multiple passengers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.
A traffic signal is coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to be careful because the road may be slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A new lane has been added.

questions.explanation: This sign means the center lane can be used by traffic from both directions to turn left only. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells drivers that a work crew may be on or near the road. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes to the right ahead.
Hiking trails are to the right.
A hotel is to the right.
A hospital is to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows that there are several lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells drivers that the right lane ahead will be closed for construction work.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that a new lane is being added to the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on that road. In bad weather or dangerous conditions, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. If you see this signal, slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can turn right or continue straight at the intersection from this lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering the road from the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane does not continue through the interchange. The lane goes off the roadway to form a ramp. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to go through the interchange, or you must exit the freeway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross this road. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Loose gravel covers the road ahead.
Sand has been spread on the road for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Loose gravel covers the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No parking zone—vehicles will be towed.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules drivers must follow. This sign means large trucks cannot use this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to warn of no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign alerts you to a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You may go if it is safe.
You must stop completely before going forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong direction and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to be careful. The bridge ahead may not be wide enough for you to safely pass a truck or meet one coming the other way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering changes, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the area ahead has low clearance. Watch out for overhead hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you that the road may be slippery when wet. Be extra careful and control your vehicle when pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children who may be in or near the roadway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Be alert for pedestrians at intersections and crosswalks, especially near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction. Be careful and stay in your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means you cannot do the action shown. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or guide rail between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive at the same speed as other traffic.
Slow down for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down. The new speed limit will appear at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that the road ahead will be redirected due to construction. Be ready to follow a different route.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you are allowed to use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a crash.
